intent: Technical Brief: HP Envy x360 System State Baseline
suggested_solution: Thermal Throttling: Run a stress test using software like Prime95 or OCCT to identify if the laptop is experiencing thermal throttling.
BIOS Update: Check for any available BIOS updates and apply them to see if it resolves the issue.
Driver Updates: Check for any driver updates and install the latest versions of the graphics, sound, and network drivers.
Power Supply Unit (PSU) Inspection: Inspect the PSU for any signs of damage or wear.
